results.title: Soula
results.content:
Every woman's story is different. Soula listens to yours.

### Running thoughts at 2am

You're lying in bed, eyes wide open. Your brain keeps replaying that argument, worrying about money, and planning tomorrow — sleep just won't come.

### Unexpected life changes

A breakup. Losing your job. A scary diagnosis. Moving to a new city. Big changes hit fast — and everyone still expects you to just keep going.

### Carrying others' lives

You remember your kid's dentist appointment, check on your mom's pills, and listen to your friend cry on the phone — but no one asks how you're holding up.

### Fears of parenting [...] ### Fears of parenting

Trying to get pregnant and it's not happening. Waiting on a test result. Worrying if the baby's okay. Wondering if you're already doing it wrong — the fear starts long before the baby arrives.

### Losing connection

You used to talk for hours. Now it's just texts about who's picking up the kids and whose turn it is to cook.

## Live demo of Soula

1Take the 30-second check-inTell Soula how you're feeling.

2Get your cardIt reflects your state right now — and where it's heading.

3Talk it throughSoula unpacks your card and talks through how you feel.

### Did sleep come easy?

One tap. So I know where you're starting from.

## Most apps are built for everybody

Soula was built for women — and only women.

Woman looking at her phone, not feeling okay [...] Yes. Everything in your account is encrypted and private by design — we never sell your data, and we only share it with the trusted processors described in our Privacy Policy. You decide how much to share, and you can delete it all anytime.

You're not alone, and you won't hit a paywall. If things ever get dark, Soula recognizes it and points you to real human help — always free. See the full list of hotlines on theCrisis resources page.

That's the whole point. Soula reflects what you're feeling instead of fixing it, and remembers you across days and weeks. The more you share, the better she knows you. Try the check-in above and feel it for yourself.

You can start free — your first check-ins and crisis support cost nothing.
